summary: Live Oak Public Library urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate's core funding and support for schools and libraries, emphasizing the critical role of E-Rate in providing reliable, affordable connectivity for students and communities.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate, libraries would have to reduce hours and services to cover the difference
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, if e-rate were lost, we would have to reduce hours and other services to cover the difference.
